notes: Global switch for the automatic publisher-feed lane. Enabled on the integration branch for preview verification; cron starts only on a production release. Per-source switches live in config/feeds.json (sources.<id>.publisherFeed.enabled). Withdraw a card by adding { "id": "...", "reason": "...", "at": "YYYY-MM-DD" } or { "url": "https://...", ... } and redeploying. Withdrawals take effect at the next deployment, not instantly. Automatic country pins are off until supported event locations can be established. Publisher feeds do not become editor-approved stories.
